title: Comparatives and preference
subject: Arabic
source: Written for arabic/y9 lesson 24 (Pupil PDF worksheet: comparatives and preference)
intro: Lesson 24: Preferences and comparatives: أُفَضِّلُ ... لِأَنَّهُ أَسْرَعُ. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

panels.title: Preference
points: أُفَضِّلُ X عَلَى Y: I prefer X to Y

model.title: Which do you prefer: the bus or the bicycle?

parts.label: Why it works
parts.text: A preference with two reasons and a 'but'

questions.q: Compare the car and the bus (price).
questions.a: السَّيَّارَةُ أَغْلَى مِنَ الحَافِلَةِ / الحَافِلَةُ أَرْخَصُ مِنَ السَّيَّارَةِ

questions.q: Preference paragraph in the portal response box: compare three modes of transport using at least three comparatives and give your preference with two reasons. Start: 'أُفَضِّلُ ... عَلَى ... لِأَنَّ ...'
Extend: the superlative: القِطَارُ أَسْرَعُ وَسِيلَةٍ.
questions.a: The train is the fastest means

questions.q: 'The plane is faster than the train' is ...
questions.a: A) الطَّائِرَةُ أَسْرَعُ مِنَ القِطَارِ. Comparative أَسْرَعُ مِنْ, no feminine change.

questions.q: Think again: is the fastest always best?
questions.a: No: slower can be cheaper, safer or greener.
